identity_integrity.question: Catalog number, performer, date, series and source CTA remain correctly attached to the work.

specificity.question: The core judgment cannot be reused by only changing the performer or catalog number.

originality.question: The angle, opening, section logic and conclusion differ from recent reviews.

narrative_coherence.question: Creative reconstruction forms a coherent, engaging reading rather than disconnected invented details.

analysis_depth.question: The review turns its premise and creative reconstruction into a meaningful interpretation.

search_value.question: Catalog number, performer and core topic terms appear naturally without stuffing.

decision_value.question: Readers can tell both who the work may suit and who may prefer something else.

low_repetition.question: Sections answer different questions and do not recycle the same claim.
